name: Agreeing-Blocks Ample Class
definition: Let $D=\{0,1\}^3\setminus\{111\}$ and $s=110$. On two disjoint three-coordinate blocks take $C_{\mathrm{ab}}=(D\times\{s\})\cup(\{s\}\times D)$.
properties: It has thirteen concepts and exactly eleven minimally missing patterns: the two all-one block triples and nine mixed pairs. The two large patterns have disjoint supports, so the class is geometrically realizable, ample, maximum-generated, and dismantlable ample. No coordinate reflection is intersection-closed. Its Horn-renaming defect is exactly one, so no coordinate reflection is a conditional antimatroid.
